note.zh: 力量（强壮）或知识（天资聪颖），决定新物种的第一个特质。
note.en: Might (Strong) or knowledge (Natural Intellectuals) decides the new species' first trait.

note.zh: 勤奋（无产者）或创新/直感（足智多谋）；两篇标题都是“去往繁星”，之后再选“循规蹈矩”（保守主义）或“勇于挑战”（仰望星空）。
note.en: Diligence (Proles) or creativity/intuition (Ingenious); both are titled “To the Stars”, followed by “Preserve the old ways” (Conservative) or “Challenge every frontier” (Starborn).

note.zh: 拒绝游戏，用电磁脉冲关闭全息空间，带回其处理器核心；获得合金与大量星界丝缕，探索结束。
note.en: Refusing the game, an EMP dissolves the hologram and its processor core is brought back; alloys and a large astral thread reward; the exploration ends.

note.zh: 模拟结束，按三次选择塑造的新物种真实出现，被安置在离裂隙最近的己方殖民地上；获得大量星界丝缕（格式塔帝国另得社会学研究与“创世洞见”）。探索结束。
note.en: The simulation ends and the species shaped by the three choices appears for real, settled on the empire's colony nearest the rift; a large astral thread reward (gestalt empires also gain society research and Genesis Insight). The exploration ends.

notes.zh: 抽取权重 1；若银河中已有帝国正在探索“创世”（全局标记 genesis_rift_being_explored，由 2398/2399 在探索开始/结束时设置/清除），或帝国没有可居住的殖民地，则为 0。
notes.en: Draw weight 1; 0 while any empire is exploring a Genesis rift (global flag genesis_rift_being_explored, set/cleared by 2398/2399 at exploration start/end) or if the empire has no habitable colony.

scope.zh: 已核对裂隙定义（全局锁定与殖民地条件）、2300–2330 全部事件、物种特质叠加与 2398/2399 锁定事件。
scope.en: Checked the rift definition (global lock and colony condition), every event 2300–2330, the stacked species traits and the 2398/2399 lock events.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现那个新世界的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of that new world appears here.
